## Executive Profile
Motivator, Software Architect, Full-Stack Nerd.
- Can bring a project from concept to production
- Can lead development and orchestrate architecture
- Can design, build and deliver software

Published Author, Conference Speaker, and Technology Community Evangelist for Adobe and Microsoft. Designed and implemented +500 systems involving APIs (SOAP/XML, REST/JSON, JWT) with security built into the system's DNA. Extensive experience across startups, scale-ups, and complex government organizations, using SCRUM, Business Process Management, and ISO certification standards.

## Chronological Experience

### 2021 – 2026: Principal Architect & Board Advisor (Copenhagen & Bangkok)
Independent executive advisory, AI-native systems architecture, and board-level technology strategy across Europe and Southeast Asia.

### 2019 Oct – 2021 Dec: Co-Founder & CTO at THIRD CIRCLE (Thailand, Startup)
Designed, architected, and implemented a Peer-to-Peer Match-Making Financing Platform for Small Loans backed by unpaid invoices and non-tangible assets. Triple redundancy setup with HyperLedger Fabric across IBM, Amazon, and Microsoft Clouds.
Tech: NodeJS, TypeScript, Ionic Framework, Angular, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS.

### 2017 Sep – 2019 Oct: Co-Founder & CTO at POWERDRIVE.IO (Thailand, Startup)
Designed, architected, and implemented the world's first real-time General Aviation Booking Engine (Private & Business Air Charter) using TensorFlow ML and Big Data for real-time complex mission quotations. Applied through Thai Aerospace Services, Pacific Aerospace Services, and Jefferson Waterman International Sky Division.
Tech: NodeJS, IBM Strongloop, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sockets, Angular, AWS.

### 2016 Jun – 2018 Jul: Station Manager at Thai Aerospace Services (Singapore)
Planned, projected, and managed aviation operations for HondaJet and Gulfstream operated by TAS.
Skills: Project Management, Organization Setup, Air Operations Oversight, Crew Management, Spareparts Inventory Management.

### 2014 Apr – 2017 Sep: Lead Engineer at Singapore Technologies, Electronics & Engineering, SatCom Division (Singapore)
Designed, architected, and served as Lead Developer on the Next Generation Management Platform for Sub-Orbital Communication Satellites for both Civilian & Military Applications.
Tech: Web Standards, Java Enterprise, Qt+, Python, C++, IBM Strongloop, NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript.

### 2013 Oct – 2014 Jan: Co-Founder, Software Architect at WeDoCode (Singapore, Startup)
Assembled a team of 6 (5 developers, 1 sales consultant) and built an online edutainment platform for children in Singapore. Exited quickly after launch through acquisition.
Tech: ASP.NET MVC, C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS.

### 2011 Sep – 2013 Oct: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Scope Secure (Malaysia)
Advanced technology projects for the Malaysian Ministry of Defense and the Petrochemical Industry: security systems for military vehicles, perimeter security for oil refineries, vessel tracking and incident monitoring in the Malacca Strait.
Tech: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Adobe Flex, ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server.

### 2009 Oct – 2011 Aug: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Scope Consult (Malaysia)
Advanced technology projects for the Malaysian Ministry of Health: Iris Scanner patient identification, 80 vehicle-based rural Methadone field clinics, Counterfeit-Prevention System, and a Hospital Maternity Ward Equipment Hub.
Tech: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Adobe Flex, ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server.

### 2004 Sep – 2009 Oct: Lead Developer & Senior Software Architect at Hello Group (Denmark)
Simultaneously with BSc/MSc studies. Projects: Danish Ministry of Energy (MyHome intelligent home energy automation), F.L.Smidth (Cement Factory Simulator), Novo Nordisk (The Diabetes Barometer).
Tech: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Adobe Flex, ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server.

### 2002 Aug – 2004 Sep: Co-Founder, Full Stack Developer at Bluefish (Denmark, Startup)
Digital Agency in Copenhagen.
Tech: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server.

### 1997 Jul – 2002 Sep: Freelance Developer (Denmark)
Early web & enterprise software engineering.
